objects.name: sysbuild_projects
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_projects (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    system_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    phase_name TEXT,
    build_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (build_type IN ('outsource','procurement','inhouse')),
    goal TEXT,
    oa_number TEXT CHECK (oa_number IS NULL OR (oa_number GLOB '[0-9]*' AND oa_number NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND length(oa_number) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)),
    initiated_on DATE CHECK (initiated_on IS NULL OR (initiated_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(initiated_on,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(initiated_on,'+0 days') = initiated_on AND initiated_on BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    pm_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','paused','terminated','closed')),
    history_window TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'never' CHECK (history_window IN ('never','open','closed')),
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime'))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_parties
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_parties (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    side TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('demand','dev')),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime'))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_members
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_members (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    party_id INTEGER,
    user_id INTEGER,
    person_name TEXT,
    joined_at DATETIME,
    removed_at DATETIME,
    removed_reason TEXT,
    added_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (user_id IS NOT NULL OR (person_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(person_name)) > 0)),
    CHECK ((removed_at IS NULL) = (removed_reason IS NULL))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_appointments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_appointments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    party_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','active','rejected','ended','withdrawn')),
    proposed_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    effective_at DATETIME,
    ended_at DATETIME,
    end_reason TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('active','ended') OR effective_at IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (status IN ('active','ended') OR effective_at IS NULL),
    CHECK ((status = 'ended') = (ended_at IS NOT NULL))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_delegations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_delegations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    party_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    appointment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_owner' CHECK (status IN ('pending_owner','pending_accept','active','rejected','revoked','withdrawn')),
    proposed_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    effective_at DATETIME,
    revoked_at DATETIME,
    revoke_reason TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('active','revoked') OR effective_at IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (status IN ('active','revoked') OR effective_at IS NULL),
    CHECK ((status = 'revoked') = (revoked_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (revoked_at IS NULL OR (revoke_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(revoke_reason)) > 0))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_invitations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_invitations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('join','appointment')),
    appointment_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','declined','withdrawn')),
    invited_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    responded_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((kind = 'appointment') = (appointment_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'pending') = (responded_at IS NULL))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_batches
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_batches (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seq INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq >= 1),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_default IN (0,1)),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planning' CHECK (status IN ('planning','active','live','transferred','superseded')),
    superseded_by INTEGER,
    transfer_change_id INTEGER,
    dev_assignee_member_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((status = 'transferred') = (transfer_change_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'superseded') = (superseded_by IS NOT NULL))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_nodes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_nodes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    batch_id INTEGER,
    template_key TEXT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    g_stage TEXT,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
    is_golive_milestone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_golive_milestone IN (0,1)),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK (status IN ('not_started','in_progress','closed','cancelled')),
    opened_at DATETIME,
    closed_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (is_golive_milestone = 0 OR (batch_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'cancelled')),
    CHECK ((status = 'closed') = (closed_at IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('in_progress','closed') OR opened_at IS NOT NULL)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_node_schedule_records
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_node_schedule_records (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    node_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('baseline','plan_change','actual_start','actual_end','actual_correct')),
    planned_start DATE CHECK (planned_start IS NULL OR (planned_start GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(planned_start,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(planned_start,'+0 days') = planned_start AND planned_start BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    planned_end DATE CHECK (planned_end IS NULL OR (planned_end GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(planned_end,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(planned_end,'+0 days') = planned_end AND planned_end BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    actual_date DATE CHECK (actual_date IS NULL OR (actual_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(actual_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(actual_date,'+0 days') = actual_date AND actual_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    corrects_kind TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    source_party_id INTEGER,
    dev_key_entry_id INTEGER,
    package_version_id INTEGER,
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (kind NOT IN ('baseline','plan_change') OR (planned_start IS NOT NULL AND planned_end IS NOT NULL AND planned_start <= planned_end AND actual_date IS NULL)),
    CHECK (kind IN ('baseline','plan_change') OR (actual_date IS NOT NULL AND planned_start IS NULL AND planned_end IS NULL)),
    CHECK (kind <> 'baseline' OR package_version_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (kind NOT IN ('plan_change','actual_correct') OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0)),
    CHECK ((kind = 'actual_correct') = (corrects_kind IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (corrects_kind IS NULL OR corrects_kind IN ('actual_start','actual_end')),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_modules
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_modules (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

objects.name: sysbuild_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (code GLOB 'R-[0-9]*' AND substr(code,3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
    module_id INTEGER,
    replaces_item_id INTEGER,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime'))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_item_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_item_versions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version_no >= 1),
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    quote_text TEXT,
    proposer_name TEXT,
    proposer_member_id INTEGER,
    proposer_party_id INTEGER,
    occasion TEXT,
    proposed_on DATE CHECK (proposed_on IS NULL OR (proposed_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(proposed_on,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(proposed_on,'+0 days') = proposed_on AND proposed_on BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    proposer_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (proposer_status IN ('pending','confirmed','proxy_confirmed','denied')),
    deny_reason TEXT,
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (proposer_member_id IS NOT NULL OR (proposer_name IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(proposer_name)) > 0)),
    CHECK (proposer_status <> 'denied' OR (deny_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(deny_reason)) > 0)),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_packages
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_packages (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    batch_id INTEGER,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('initiation','overall','batch_req','overall_batch_req','batch_accept','change','closing')),
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (type NOT IN ('batch_req','overall_batch_req','batch_accept') OR batch_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (type NOT IN ('initiation','overall','closing') OR batch_id IS NULL)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_package_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_package_versions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    package_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    version_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version_no >= 1),
    parent_overall_version_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','pending','effective','superseded')),
    effective_at DATETIME,
    snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(snapshot_json)),
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status <> 'effective' OR effective_at IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('draft','pending') OR effective_at IS NULL)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_package_item_revisions

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_package_item_revisions (

  )

objects.name: sysbuild_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_entries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    node_id INTEGER,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('note','material','lesson','benefit','correction','feedback','issue')),
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general' CHECK (purpose IN ('general','dev_note','deliverable')),
    commitment_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (commitment_flag IN (0,1)),
    commitment_flag_source TEXT CHECK (commitment_flag_source IS NULL OR commitment_flag_source IN ('submitter','pm')),
    is_risk INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_risk IN (0,1)),
    source_party_id INTEGER,
    source_name TEXT,
    operator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    operator_identity_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(operator_identity_snapshot)),
    period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('process','supplement')),
    days_after_close INTEGER,
    business_date DATE CHECK (business_date IS NULL OR (business_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(business_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(business_date,'+0 days') = business_date AND business_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    routing_json TEXT CHECK (routing_json IS NULL OR json_valid(routing_json)),
    from_comment_id INTEGER,
    parent_entry_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((commitment_flag = 1) = (commitment_flag_source IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((period = 'supplement') = (days_after_close IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (days_after_close IS NULL OR days_after_close >= 0),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_entry_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_entry_items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

  )

objects.name: sysbuild_entry_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_entry_actions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('conclude','for_reference','correct','void','link_change','link_sys_issue','assign_items','split','escalate','mark_commitment','adjudicate')),
    conclusion_kind TEXT CHECK (conclusion_kind IS NULL OR conclusion_kind IN ('handled','adopted','not_adopted','deferred','to_change','to_sys_iteration','no_further','project_terminated')),
    basis_kind TEXT CHECK (basis_kind IS NULL OR basis_kind IN ('dev_note_version','pm_verify')),
    basis_ref INTEGER,
    text TEXT,
    sys_issue_no TEXT,
    assignee_text TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((action IN ('conclude','adjudicate')) = (conclusion_kind IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (basis_kind IS NULL OR basis_ref IS NOT NULL OR basis_kind = 'pm_verify'),
    CHECK (action <> 'link_sys_issue' OR (sys_issue_no IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(sys_issue_no)) > 0))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_changes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_changes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    affects_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(affects_json)),
    package_version_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','pending','effective','withdrawn')),
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status <> 'effective' OR package_version_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_confirm_tasks
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_confirm_tasks (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    object_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (object_type IN ('package_version','item_version','invitation','delegation','dev_entry','conclusion','adjudication','handover')),
    object_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    object_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('package_confirm','proposer_confirm','accept_invitation','delegation_grant','delegation_accept','dev_key_confirm','conclusion_confirm','adjudicate','handover_accept')),
    party_id INTEGER,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (object_type NOT IN ('invitation','delegation') OR object_version_id = object_id)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_confirm_task_revisions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_confirm_task_revisions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    rev_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rev_no >= 1),
    required_member_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    basis_appointment_id INTEGER,
    basis_delegation_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','confirmed','objected','rejected','invalid','superseded')),
    status_reason TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status NOT IN ('invalid','superseded') OR (status_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(status_reason)) > 0))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_confirmations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_confirmations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    task_revision_id INTEGER,
    object_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (object_type IN ('package_version','item_version','invitation','delegation','dev_entry','conclusion','adjudication','handover')),
    object_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    actor_user_id INTEGER,
    actual_confirmer TEXT,
    identity_basis TEXT,
    method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('platform','card','proxy','history')),
    decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (decision IN ('confirm','object','reject')),
    checkbox_text TEXT,
    reason TEXT,
    view_id INTEGER,
    external_date DATE CHECK (external_date IS NULL OR (external_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(external_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(external_date,'+0 days') = external_date AND external_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    proxy_by INTEGER,
    card_instance_id INTEGER,
    dingtalk_user_id TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((method = 'history') = (task_revision_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (method <> 'platform' OR (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND view_id IS NOT NULL AND checkbox_text IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(checkbox_text)) > 0)),
    CHECK (method <> 'card' OR (actor_user_id IS NOT NULL AND card_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND dingtalk_user_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (method NOT IN ('proxy','history') OR (external_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_confirmer IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(actual_confirmer)) > 0 AND identity_basis IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(identity_basis)) > 0 AND view_id IS NULL AND checkbox_text IS NULL)),
    CHECK (method NOT IN ('proxy','history') OR proxy_by IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (decision = 'confirm' OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(reason)) > 0))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_views
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_views (

    object_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (object_type IN ('package_version','item_version','invitation','delegation','dev_entry','conclusion','adjudication','handover')),

  )

objects.name: sysbuild_comments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_comments (

    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    object_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    author_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    mentions_json TEXT CHECK (mentions_json IS NULL OR json_valid(mentions_json)),
    upgraded_entry_id INTEGER,

objects.name: sysbuild_attachments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_attachments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    original_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    mime_type TEXT,
    size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size >= 0),
    sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 64 AND sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    is_image INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_image IN (0,1)),
    supersedes_attachment_id INTEGER,
    uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    staged_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    deleted_at DATETIME,
    deleted_by INTEGER,
    masked_at DATETIME,
    masked_by INTEGER,
    mask_reason TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((deleted_at IS NULL) = (deleted_by IS NULL)),
    CHECK ((masked_at IS NULL) = (masked_by IS NULL)),
    CHECK (masked_at IS NULL OR (mask_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(mask_reason)) > 0))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_attachment_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_attachment_bindings (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    attachment_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    owner_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (owner_type IN ('entry','item_version','material_version','confirmation','change','golive_event','history_import','comment','schedule_record','package_version','event')),
    owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    bound_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    bound_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime'))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_frozen_attachments
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_frozen_attachments (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

    object_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL,

    change_package_version_id INTEGER,

objects.name: sysbuild_routing_snapshots

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_routing_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    part_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (part_no >= 1),
    overall_package_version_id INTEGER,
    item_version_id INTEGER,
    committed_batch_id INTEGER,
    golive_event_id INTEGER,
    decided_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    trigger_action_id INTEGER,
    route TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (route IN ('project','sys_iteration','pending')),
    CHECK (route = 'pending' OR (overall_package_version_id IS NOT NULL AND item_version_id IS NOT NULL AND committed_batch_id IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (route <> 'sys_iteration' OR golive_event_id IS NOT NULL)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_history_imports

    identity_basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(identity_basis)) > 0),
    original_date DATE NOT NULL CHECK (original_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(original_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(original_date,'+0 days') = original_date AND original_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31'),

objects.name: sysbuild_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_entries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    node_id INTEGER,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('note','material','lesson','benefit','correction','feedback','issue')),
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general' CHECK (purpose IN ('general','dev_note','deliverable')),
    commitment_flag INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (commitment_flag IN (0,1)),
    commitment_flag_source TEXT CHECK (commitment_flag_source IS NULL OR commitment_flag_source IN ('submitter','pm')),
    is_risk INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_risk IN (0,1)),
    source_party_id INTEGER,
    source_name TEXT,
    operator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    operator_identity_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(operator_identity_snapshot)),
    period TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (period IN ('process','supplement')),
    days_after_close INTEGER,
    business_date DATE CHECK (business_date IS NULL OR (business_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND date(business_date,'+0 days') IS NOT NULL AND date(business_date,'+0 days') = business_date AND business_date BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2099-12-31')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    routing_json TEXT CHECK (routing_json IS NULL OR json_valid(routing_json)),
    from_comment_id INTEGER,
    parent_entry_id INTEGER,
    objects_entry_id INTEGER,
    revision_of_entry_id INTEGER,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((parent_entry_id IS NOT NULL) + (objects_entry_id IS NOT NULL) + (revision_of_entry_id IS NOT NULL) <= 1),
    CHECK ((commitment_flag = 1) = (commitment_flag_source IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((period = 'supplement') = (days_after_close IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (days_after_close IS NULL OR days_after_close >= 0),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_entry_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_entry_actions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('conclude','for_reference','correct','void','link_change','link_sys_issue','assign_items','split','escalate','mark_commitment','adjudicate','unmark_commitment','mark_risk','unmark_risk')),
    conclusion_kind TEXT CHECK (conclusion_kind IS NULL OR conclusion_kind IN ('handled','adopted','not_adopted','deferred','to_change','to_sys_iteration','no_further','project_terminated')),
    basis_kind TEXT CHECK (basis_kind IS NULL OR basis_kind IN ('dev_note_version','pm_verify')),
    basis_ref INTEGER,
    text TEXT,
    sys_issue_no TEXT,
    assignee_text TEXT,
    change_id INTEGER,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK ((action IN ('conclude','adjudicate')) = (conclusion_kind IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (basis_kind IS NULL OR basis_ref IS NOT NULL OR basis_kind = 'pm_verify'),
    CHECK (action <> 'link_sys_issue' OR (sys_issue_no IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(sys_issue_no)) > 0)),
    CHECK (change_id IS NULL OR action IN ('conclude','link_change')),
    CHECK (action <> 'conclude' OR ((conclusion_kind = 'to_change') = (change_id IS NOT NULL))),
    CHECK (action <> 'link_change' OR change_id IS NOT NULL)
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_changes

    affects_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(affects_json)),
    package_version_id INTEGER,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','pending','effective','withdrawn')),
    no_written_evidence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (no_written_evidence IN (0,1)),
    no_evidence_reason TEXT,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (status <> 'effective' OR package_version_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (no_written_evidence = 0 OR (no_evidence_reason IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(no_evidence_reason)) >= 10))
  )

objects.name: sysbuild_routing_snapshots
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_routing_snapshots (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    part_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (part_no >= 1),
    overall_package_version_id INTEGER,
    item_version_id INTEGER,
    committed_batch_id INTEGER,
    golive_event_id INTEGER,
    decided_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    trigger_action_id INTEGER,
    route TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (route IN ('project','sys_iteration','pending')),
    basis_category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis_category IN ('in_plan','planned_detail','out_of_plan','undetermined')),
    CHECK ((route = 'pending') = (basis_category = 'undetermined')),
    CHECK (basis_category <> 'undetermined' OR (overall_package_version_id IS NULL AND item_version_id IS NULL AND committed_batch_id IS NULL AND golive_event_id IS NULL)),
    CHECK (basis_category <> 'in_plan' OR (overall_package_version_id IS NOT NULL AND item_version_id IS NOT NULL AND route IN ('project', 'sys_iteration')
      AND (route <> 'project' OR committed_batch_id IS NOT NULL) AND (route <> 'sys_iteration' OR golive_event_id IS NOT NULL))),
    CHECK (basis_category <> 'planned_detail' OR (item_version_id IS NOT NULL AND route = 'project')),
    CHECK (basis_category <> 'out_of_plan' OR (item_version_id IS NULL AND route IN ('sys_iteration', 'project')))
  )

    object_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    object_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('package_confirm','proposer_confirm','accept_invitation','delegation_grant','delegation_accept','dev_key_confirm','conclusion_confirm','adjudicate','handover_accept','handover_accept_issue','handover_no_further')),
    party_id INTEGER,
    created_by INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
    CHECK (object_type NOT IN ('invitation','delegation') OR object_version_id = object_id)
  )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sysbuild_notice_objections (
